The docs show how to set the embedding model globally, but the excerpts I have don't include the exact line for setting the LLM.

**Embedding model:** Set `Settings.embed_model`. The usage section shows the pattern: "# changing the global default" followed by "Settings.embed_model = OpenAIEmbedding()" [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/module_guides/models/embeddings.md]. The Getting Started section recommends setting an explicit model for new projects, because without it LlamaIndex falls back to "`OpenAIEmbedding`'s default of `text-embedding-ada-002`" [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/module_guides/models/embeddings.md]. The example there is `OpenAIEmbedding(model="text-embedding-3-sma...`, but the excerpt is truncated, so I can't confirm the full model name from it.

**LLM:** The excerpts don't show the exact line for setting the LLM on `Settings`. The migration guide says the global Settings are the place to change defaults. It also gives an example for non-OpenAI setups that starts with "from llama_index.llms.ollama import Ollama", but that excerpt is cut off before the assignment [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/module_guides/supporting_modules/service_context_migration.md]. I don't want to guess the exact attribute from these excerpts. Check the full settings page for the LLM attribute.

**How the global default works:** "Whenever a particular component is not provided, the `Settings` object is used to provide it as a global default." [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/module_guides/supporting_modules/settings.md]. Because it is global, "Configuring the global settings means you are change the default for EVERY module in LlamaIndex." [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/module_guides/supporting_modules/service_context_migration.md] You can also pass a model directly into an interface to override the global setting for that component: "Local configurations (transformations, LLMs, embedding models) can be passed directly into the interfaces that make use of them." [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/module_guides/supporting_modules/settings.md]
